name: cooper-labs
description: Cooper Labs' Claude plugins: the brand kit, the document templates and the social cards.

plugins.name: cooper-brand
plugins.description: Cooper Labs' brand kit for documents and social: the A4 internal-document template with sixteen page styles (proposal, case study, spec, post-mortem, memo, guide, report), the 16:9 deck, the A4 fact sheet, the meeting note, the quote, the social cards from the Figma file (post, partner, X cover, social preview) in eleven sizes, banners, threads, the animated MP4, the brand renders by number and the script that renders new ones. Built from a JSON description, rendered with Chromium, checked before it goes out.
